lines.text: The word of God came to John son of Zechariah in the wilderness while Annas and Caiaphas were high priests.
John preached a baptism of repentance around the Jordan, as Isaiah wrote of a voice calling in the wilderness.
John told the crowds not to say "We have Moses as our lawgiver," and said the axe lies ready.
John told tax collectors to collect no more than authorized, and soldiers to be content with their armor.
John rebuked Herod the tetrarch over Herodias and his evils, and Herod locked John up in prison.
